command: cd /workspace; ls; cat mcp.json | sed 's/\(Bearer \)[^"]*/\1***/'; which mcpjam; npx --no-install mcpjam --help 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -60; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md | head -80; npm view @mcpjam/cli version 2>&1 | tail -2
cd /workspace; npx -y @mcpjam/cli server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --rpc --out doctor.json 2>&1 | head -50

cd /workspace; for args in '{"a":2,"b":3}' '{"a":1.5,"b":-4}' '{"a":"x","b":1}'; do echo "== $args"; npx -y @mcpjam/cli tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --tool-name add --tool-args "$args" 2>&1 | cut -c1-500; done | tee tools-calls.log
